A power-packed batting display followed by a clinical bowling effort!
Max Bryant smashed 44 off just 20 balls, while Kieron Pollard chipped in with a quickfire 23 as UAE Bulls posted 117/7. Mohammad Amir and Shadab Khan then picked up two wickets each to help their side defeat Yas Lions by 26 runs.
